message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a red background with black and white graphics. At the top, black text reads "TEMPO" in a large serif font, underlined by smaller text: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above this, smaller headings include "KONTEKS POLITIK SKANDAL FIRZA-RIZIEQ" and "JEJARING MAFIA IMPORTIR SAPI".

Centered on the right is the white text "INVESTIGASI TAMASYA NAPI SUKAMISKIN". Below, smaller black text describes paying officers and corruption convicts leaving prison for pleasure. 

The main graphic occupies the lower half, showing a black silhouette of a prison structure with a watchtower on the left and a building with several vertical red windows on the right. A white beam of light projects diagonally downward from the watchtower’s lamp. Within this beam is a black silhouette of a person wearing a hat and backpack, stepping down a series of white stairs formed by the edge of the light. The stairs lead to the bottom edge. A barcode and small text indicating "6-12 FEBRUARI 2017" and "RP 45.000" are in the bottom left corner.
